name: Payment totals
description: Validates payment events from Pub/Sub, deduplicates them, and writes per-merchant totals for event-time windows to BigQuery. Rejected messages go to a dead-letter table.

parameters.name: window_seconds
parameters.label: Window size in seconds
parameters.helpText: Length of each event-time window. Default 60.

parameters.name: allowed_lateness_seconds
parameters.label: Allowed lateness in seconds
parameters.helpText: How long after a window closes a late event still corrects it. Default 120.
